forward_debts_explicit.label: NOT VALID + VALIDATE discipline for grant FK on data-bearing contours
forward_debts_explicit.description: Migration 021 adds grant_role_id_fkey as an immediately-validated FK (no NOT VALID). On the clean-replay dev/prod target this is safe (grant table is empty at d948f6b base). HAZARD: if a grant-write path (T-0029 or similar) lands before 021 is promoted to any long-lived contour that accumulated grant rows, the ALTER TABLE VALIDATE will fail with 23503 on the pre-existing non-seeded role_ids. Required discipline when grant-write-path merges: (a) add 021's FK as ADD CONSTRAINT … NOT VALID first, (b) run a reconciliation pass to purge/fix orphan grant.role_id rows, (c) then VALIDATE CONSTRAINT separately. Alternatively, assert grant table is empty as a pre-021 migration guard.
forward_debts_explicit.when_triggered: Only if a grant-write path (e.g., T-0029) lands and accumulates non-seeded grant rows on a long-lived contour BEFORE this branch is merged.
